mentions.name: Greenlight social
mentions.description: This app lets friend groups coordinate activities with a single button press instead of asking "Does anyone want to join X?". Users create a group per activity (e.g. "Play Dota 2" or "Beer at local pub"), and "going green" signals they are ready, triggering a push notification like "Paul is greenlit!" to the other group members. It aims to lower the threshold for initiating get-togethers by cutting down logistics chatter.
mentions.problem: Group communication around activities revolves around logistics, and the typical "Does anyone want to join x activity?" message has a high threshold; the app lowers the barrier for initiating.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Greenlight social.
It's basically an app for saying "I'm ready" or "Let's do x...".
